limitations: Authored AOT only; no original game code was linked or executed.
Five narrower load selectors and three exact numeric conversion entrypoints are experimental. They do not implement numeric stores, arithmetic, FSCALE, MMX coherence or older producer metadata.

Numeric helper ABI has explicit raw fields and static offset/size checks. Each call restores SoftFloat rounding, tininess, precision and sticky flags; four concurrent threads independently verify 262144 calls.

FLD/FILD widen exactly regardless of guest precision control. SoftFloat supplies widened values and signaling-NaN invalid; explicit source-bit classification supplies DE. Stack exceptions have instruction-level priority. Unmasked denormal loads still push; unmasked invalid or stack overflow suppress the push.

Hardware comparison covers 1351740 authored cases with all TOP values/occupancy patterns, masks/stickies, single/double specials, signed integer limits, 4096 deterministic random payloads per form/profile and two explicit pointer/opcode policies. Undefined C0/C2/C3 are excluded; C1 and other defined effects remain checked.

Host pointer comparisons retain the earlier low32 isolation limit. Full native logical pointers and metadata calls remain checked separately. The always-update profile is an explicit policy, not AMD Jaguar hardware evidence.
238606 matched hardware faults; 30 extra native pending-before-unsupported cases and 30 unsupported mapping cases are separate. General guest mappings and PS4 exception delivery remain open.

The FOP correction is experimental in compiler v6; accepted startup objects remain from v5 with v9-sqrt semantics. Existing raw/stack/fault and sparse/trap regressions pass, but prior compiled objects are not silently relabeled corrected.
